summary: Carry PR sjawhar/legion#2266 (cards as asides while ctx.isIdle() is false, steers with triggerTurn when idle) onto legion/INFRA-497; change the isIdle-missing case to main's steer; add a pi-envoy wake for a card the host folds with no turn (late fold under the interrupt latch, or plan mode), decided by branch order plus isIdle and runSeq, sent as nextTurn+triggerTurn with LOCAL_ENVOY_NOTICE, skipped for a targeted Aside and after a user interrupt (aborted assistant 'Interrupted by user', auto_compaction_end.aborted, cleared at agent_start); prove it on the pinned Oh My Pi in RPC mode with a real nats-server (LEGION_TEST_NATS_URL) in a new packages/pi-envoy/extensions/card-delivery-omp.test.ts; CI pi-envoy job gets a nats:2.10 service container.
tasks: 1. Rebase PR #2266's commits b707146e and 67bc2ad9 onto main on legion/INFRA-497 with jj, keeping their author; resolve CHANGELOG/AGENTS.md conflicts keeping both; open the issue PR from legion/INFRA-497 (body 'Dispatch: INFRA-497', squash title 'fix(pi-envoy): ...'); comment on #2266 naming the new PR and close it, leaving its branch.

2. Unit tests red then green in packages/pi-envoy/extensions/envoy.test.ts: the PR's four tests (isIdle-missing case now expects a steer); wake once for a folded card with message_end before and after agent_end; one wake for three folded cards; no wake for a card with a later assistant entry, a targeted Aside, after an 'Interrupted by user' aborted assistant, after auto_compaction_end aborted, after an agent_start, isIdle false at the check, no isIdle, the identity notice, shutdown before the check; wake after a non-interrupt abort; flag cleared at agent_start.

3. Implement the wake and the isIdle-missing steer in packages/pi-envoy/extensions/envoy.ts inside the existing message_end/agent_start/agent_end handlers plus an auto_compaction_end handler; types in packages/pi-shared/src/pi-types.ts.
4. packages/pi-shared/test/omp-harness.ts: messageStream takes an optional input-token usage reported in message_start.

5. Real-binary test packages/pi-envoy/extensions/card-delivery-omp.test.ts: cases (a) 5 cards then a Send while a model request is held -> Send first in request k+1, ahead of all cards, no spurious later request; (b) RPC abort and abort_and_restore_queue, held model request and during a tool, 3 queued cards -> no new request, cards in the session file and in the probe prompt's request; (c) latch from RPC abort, idle card run, post-run auto-compaction held (compaction.thresholdTokens, asyncEnabled false, autoContinue false, keepRecentTokens 1, methodOrder [soft], midTurnEnabled false), card published while held -> non-terminal agent_end, then a request with the card and the wake; (d) idle card starts a turn; plan mode via '/plan' over RPC if the pinned build supports it. Negative controls: (a) red on main's envoy.ts, (c) red at 67bc2ad9.
6. .github/workflows/envoy-and-contracts.yaml pi-envoy job: services NATS container mirror.gcr.io/library/nats:2.10 and LEGION_TEST_NATS_URL on the Test pi-envoy step.

7. Docs: packages/pi-envoy/AGENTS.md, README.md, CHANGELOG.md (one Fixed entry), packages/pi-shared/src/interface.ts LOCAL_ENVOY_NOTICE comment, packages/pi-legion/src/phase-stall.ts:84-90 comment, packages/pi-legion/AGENTS.md phase-stall section if it lists notices.
8. Prove on the real binary; PR body E2E (implementer) line names that run.

acceptance.criterion: Cards queued while a turn runs, then a Send: the Send reaches the model at the first step after it was sent, ahead of the cards, however many came first.
acceptance.surface: pinned omp RPC + pi-envoy + real nats-server via omp-harness
acceptance.check: card-delivery-omp.test.ts case (a); red on main's envoy.ts

acceptance.criterion: A card that reaches an idle session starts a turn.
An interrupt (RPC abort; abort_and_restore_queue, the Esc path) keeps queued cards: folded, no turn, read at the next turn.
A card that lands as a turn ends, in a session interrupted earlier, gets a turn.
A card read mid-run gets no extra turn.
A targeted Aside stays an aside with no wake; a host without isIdle keeps main's steer.
Plan mode: a folded card gets a wake.

decisions: Wake decided by branch order (no assistant after the card) plus ctx.isIdle() and unchanged runSeq, not an inRun flag: the host does not order agent_end before a fold's message_end (agent-session.ts:5352-5363, runner.ts:1685-1700).

Wake sent as deliverAs nextTurn with triggerTurn (not the architect's suggested steer): it starts a turn on an idle host with no plan-mode or latch check (agent-session.ts:9299-9308) and, if the host turned busy, goes to the hidden next-turn queue rather than the steering queue, so it never waits ahead of a Send.
Interrupt flag: assistant message_end with stopReason aborted and errorMessage 'Interrupted by user', or auto_compaction_end aborted; cleared at agent_start.
ctx.isIdle missing -> steer (reverses PR #2266's aside) so no host loses a turn main gave it.
Test NATS via LEGION_TEST_NATS_URL (the daemon tests' variable); CI via a nats:2.10 service container (image envoy-client already uses); no new version pin.
PR #2266 is superseded by the issue branch's PR carrying its commits, then closed with a comment; its branch is kept. The architect may overrule before implementation.

architectAdditions.addedBy: INFRA-497 architect (Envoy message 5b47789e586cdf6f0cab5236cbd3d5bc, 2026-10-26T20:46:28Z), inside the approved spec
architectAdditions.requirement: A card that reaches pi-envoy while Oh My Pi is still starting (before the startup extension-send drain completes, modes/runtime-init.ts:548) must not start a turn inside that drain; after startup each such card is read by a turn on an idle session or the running turn on a busy one; never dropped, never only folded; no wait for a first real turn.
architectAdditions.signal: No host event or context state changes after the drain (extensibility/extensions/types.ts event list and ExtensionContext; nothing extension-visible between initializeExtensions returning, rpc-mode.ts:1646, and the stdin loop, rpc-mode.ts:2635). The card is its own witness: in a startup phase an idle card goes {deliverAs: followUp, triggerTurn: false}, display true, which on an idle host appends it with no turn and emits message_end (session/agent-session.ts:9360-9382); a held send starts only once the hold settles (extensibility/extensions/send-queue.ts:38-55), so its message_end is after the hold; the fold check it arms runs on the host's timer (a macrotask) while the drain loop and initializeExtensions' return are microtask-only, so a host idle at that check has no tracked send pending; the check sends the wake outside the drain and ends the phase.
architectAdditions.proof: card-delivery-omp.test.ts case 'a card that arrives while the session starts holds no RPC input': registration held inside session_start after the agent subject opens, two cards published, get_state must answer while the wake's model request is held; red against the previous envoy.ts (get_state unanswered within 5 s).
architectAdditions.planDocument: dispatch://INFRA-497/artifact/plan-md version 2, section 'Architect addition: no card's turn inside the host's startup drain'

findings.finding: The late-fold wake depended on agent_end reaching pi-envoy before the fold's message_end, which the host does not guarantee (agent-session.ts:5352-5354; runner.ts:1685-1700).
findings.answer: Design 2: the check uses branch order (no assistant after the card), ctx.isIdle() and unchanged runSeq; unit tests deliver the fold's message_end before and after agent_end, and a mid-run card handled late gets no wake; case (a) asserts no spurious request.

findings.finding: 'A fold after an interrupted run' was undefined; Esc over RPC is abort_and_restore_queue.
findings.answer: Interrupt flag defined (aborted assistant 'Interrupted by user', auto_compaction_end aborted; cleared at agent_start); case (b) runs abort and abort_and_restore_queue, each with a held model request and during a tool.

findings.finding: Plan mode must be inside the wake's scope; the PR's text lists it as a limit.
findings.answer: Design 2 states the wake fires in plan mode; unit test; real binary via '/plan' if RPC supports it; AGENTS.md/CHANGELOG rewritten to drop the plan-mode and late-fold limits.

findings.finding: Test (c) could pass without the wake if compaction schedules a continuation; no on-demand auto-compaction trigger existed.
findings.answer: Case (c) gives the settings (asyncEnabled false, autoContinue false, thresholdTokens, keepRecentTokens, methodOrder, midTurnEnabled false), a usage parameter on messageStream, and asserts the non-terminal agent_end then a request carrying the card and the wake text; red at 67bc2ad9.

findings.finding: Negative checks had no end point.
findings.answer: Each ends with RPC get_state isSettled and a probe prompt that must be the next model request.

findings.finding: The draft added a third way to provide NATS in tests and a second copy of the nats-server pin.
findings.answer: The test reads LEGION_TEST_NATS_URL (the daemon tests' variable); CI uses a service container on mirror.gcr.io/library/nats:2.10; the local go install uses the version packages/envoy/go.mod pins; AGENTS.md gets the command.

findings.finding: The wake's delivery mode, text and display were undecided; a steer in the busy race could wait ahead of a Send.
findings.answer: nextTurn+triggerTurn, display false, short text naming how many Envoy messages arrived after the last turn, details LOCAL_ENVOY_NOTICE.
